experiences.description: I developed and maintained user-facing features for Xnapper, a commercial image and video editing product, using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.
bullets: Delivered end-to-end features across React/Next.js interfaces, application state, Node.js multimedia processing, and backend services for a commercial product used by approximately 20,000 users.
Built a video editing pipeline from timeline interactions and state modeling through frame-accurate playback, FFmpeg/WASM processing, and export.
Implemented Google OAuth for the web and Electron applications, including session handling and renewal.
Built a serverless licensing backend with Node.js, Express, and Upstash Redis, enforcing per-device rules with idempotent activations.
Collaborated daily in English with an international stakeholder on product behavior, implementation details, and release-oriented improvements.

experiences.description:
I built internal web and desktop tools using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Flask, Python, and Tkinter to simplify operational workflows and reduce manual work in day-to-day processes. I implemented APIs, internal interfaces, and practical tools for a non-technical operational environment.

I also worked with SQL, pandas, and Matplotlib to make internal operational information easier to access through data processing, reporting, and queries. The role involved gathering requirements from different teams and translating business needs into usable software.
bullets: Built internal web and desktop tools with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Flask, Python, and Tkinter to simplify operational workflows and reduce manual work.
Implemented APIs and internal interfaces tailored for a non-technical operational environment.

experiences.description:
I build and improve personal projects as end-to-end products, applying full-stack development, product thinking, architecture, deployment, optimization, and testing. These projects include full-stack applications, desktop tools, APIs, authenticated flows, maps, database-backed systems, and documented deployments.

Through them, I focus on maintainable code, sound application structure, user experience, and complete features from end to end.

I provided remote technical support for CCTV, networking, and access control systems. I helped diagnose issues, assisted clients by phone, worked with remote-access tools such as TeamViewer, and supported equipment setup and troubleshooting as part of a technical team.
